title: ChatCompletionInput

messages.description: Conversation messages in turn order. The final message MUST be role=user (the host MAY relax this for completion-only providers but conformance MUST emit `role: 'user'` last). System messages MAY appear anywhere but typically at the start; hosts MAY merge them into config.systemPrompt internally.

prompt.description: Shorthand for a single user turn. `toMessages` maps it to `[{role:'user',content:<value>}]`.

text.description: Shorthand for a single user turn (alias of `prompt`).

message.description: Shorthand for a single user turn (alias of `prompt`).

content.description: Shorthand for a single user turn (alias of `prompt`).

input.description: Shorthand for a single user turn (alias of `prompt`); also the port a portless edge lands on.

description:
Input for the chat-completion node. `messages` is the CANONICAL form, but it is NOT required: `toMessages` (packs/core.openwop.ai/index.mjs) accepts, in order — (1) a non-empty `messages` array; (2) any of `prompt`/`text`/`message`/`content`/`input` as a non-empty string; (3) ANY other string-valued property; (4) all remaining structured properties, JSON-stringified into one user turn. Only a completely empty input object yields no messages.

This schema previously declared `required: ["messages"]` with `additionalProperties: false`, which was wrong in both directions: it demanded a field the node does not need, and forbade the exact alternative fields the node reads. Nothing validates node inputs at dispatch (ADR 0498 §Open), so the schema was pure documentation — and it documented a contract the implementation never had.
